_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: The Lounge
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The Lounge is a web IRC client that stays connected while you're away, keeping your channels and history. The egg runs it in private mode: people sign in with an account.
startup: h=$( (node --version; cat app/package.json) | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat app/node_modules/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing The Lounge"; (cd app && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --no-update-notifier --no-progress --loglevel=error) && npm cache clean --force --no-update-notifier --loglevel=error && echo "$h" > app/node_modules/.raptor-installed || exit 1; fi; export THELOUNGE_HOME=/home/container/data; lounge=app/node_modules/thelounge; grep -q RAPTOR_UPDATE_CHECK $lounge/dist/server/server.js || sed -i 's|changelog_1.default.checkForUpdates(manager);|if (process.env.RAPTOR_UPDATE_CHECK === "1") changelog_1.default.checkForUpdates(manager);|' $lounge/dist/server/server.js; export RAPTOR_UPDATE_CHECK="${UPDATE_CHECK}"; if [ -n "${LOUNGE_PASSWORD:-}" ] && [ ! -f "data/users/${LOUNGE_USER}.json" ]; then mkdir -p data/users && node $lounge/index.js add "${LOUNGE_USER}" --password "${LOUNGE_PASSWORD}" --save-logs || exit 1; fi; exec node $lounge/index.js start -c host=0.0.0.0 -c port={{SERVER_PORT}} -c public=false

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# The Lounge: picks the version from npm's registry and writes it to
# app/package.json; the server installs it (and its dependencies, for the
# Node.js version it runs) when it next starts. Users, settings and logs
# (data/) are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
pkg=thelounge

meta=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)" -H "Accept: application/vnd.npm.install-v1+json" "https://registry.npmjs.org/$pkg") ||
    fail "npm's registry can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
latest=$(jq -r '."dist-tags".latest' <<<"$meta")
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
want="${want#v}"
[ "$want" = latest ] && want="$latest"
jq -e --arg v "$want" '.versions[$v]' <<<"$meta" >/dev/null ||
    fail "The Lounge has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $latest, then reinstall."

mkdir -p app data
if [ -f app/package.json ] && [ "$(jq -r ".dependencies.$pkg" app/package.json)" = "$want" ]; then
    echo "The Lounge $want is already chosen."
else
    jq -n --arg v "$want" '{name: "raptor-thelounge", private: true, dependencies: {thelounge: $v}}' > app/package.json.new
    mv -f app/package.json.new app/package.json
fi
echo "Installed The Lounge $want; it's set up when the server starts."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Lounge version to install, such as 4.5.2, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Username
variables.description: The account created at the first start, when Password is set.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The first account's password. Change it later in The Lounge's settings; this only sets it when the account is created.

variables.name: Update check
variables.description: Set it to 1 to let The Lounge ask GitHub for new releases every day.
